message: Analyze this fictional runtime incident using multiple agents. Create exactly three parallel worker roles named worker and one final role named joiner. The joiner must merge the worker outputs into one memo. Evidence: session continue latency rose from 180ms to 2.4s, new workflows were still accepted, worker backlog grew from 40 to 410, and NATS reconnects spiked on one node while JetStream stayed healthy. Constraints: no schema changes in the first hour, preserve existing session_id values, choose exactly 2 mitigations, and list exactly 3 follow-up tests. Keep the final memo under 180 words.
